# Register for a user account

To apply for an account to the PEH Data Platform, go to [https://peh.vito.be/](https://peh.vito.be/) and follow the instructions.

Important note: 

Providing data to the PEH Data Platform and getting access to data from the PEH Data Platform is only possible upon signature of the [Protocol On the management and use of the Personal Exposure and Health Data Platform](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19232226)
